description: The figure is a 3D bar chart illustrating answer correctness measured as “Accuracy” for three language models across two task types. The category axes are shown on the horizontal plane: one axis lists the models “Davinci-003,” “ChatGPT,” and “BARD” (displayed as text near the front/left of the plot), and the other axis lists the task categories “Generation” and “Classification” (shown along the front/right edge). The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels at approximately 0.2 intervals (about 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8), with the bars extending from near 0 up to just under 0.9. For each model–task combination there is a single rectangular bar with a blue-to-green-to-yellow color gradient (blue near the base, yellow near the top) and shaded faces to emphasize height. Davinci-003 has a Generation bar reaching roughly 0.45 and a Classification bar reaching roughly 0.78; ChatGPT has a Generation bar around 0.20 and a Classification bar around 0.73; BARD has a Generation bar around 0.40 and a Classification bar around 0.70. The bars are not displayed with an explicit legend, do not appear stacked (each bar represents one value), and there are no visible annotations or outlines highlighting particular bars beyond the shared gradient shading; the ordering of the model labels appears as Davinci-003, then ChatGPT, then BARD.
